message: Azure specs should not be using decorator "$extension" from @typespec/openapi or @azure-tools/typespec-autorest. They will not apply to other emitter.

'GET' operation 'downloadWidgetFiles' should use method name 'get' or method name starting with 'List'. Note: If you have already shipped an SDK on top of this spec, fixing this warning may introduce a breaking change.
Only content-type 'application/json' is supported by ARM
Per the Noun_Verb convention for Operation Ids, the noun 'Widgets' should not appear after the underscore.
